plots.title: Nihal Storms the Top 3
plots.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 3rd, a rise of 23 places and a step up from 4th last week. The top 2 are now within reach of a sustained push.
plots.next: If Nihal keeps gaining, the question shifts from climbing the table to chasing the leader, 14 points back.
plots.question: How high can Nihal go?

plots.title: 3 Points Adrift
plots.text: Cherag's lead over Nihal has shrunk from 56 in GW8 to 22 in GW10, and stands at just 3 in the live GW11 figures. Nihal is closing in on the man ahead.
plots.next: If Nihal finishes ahead of Cherag this week, the head-to-head rivalry could flip completely.
plots.question: Can Nihal catch Cherag?

plots.title: Ayodele Stretches His Lead
plots.text: Ayodele holds the top spot on 728, 11 clear of Cherag on 717, after taking the crown from Cherag's 6-week reign in GW10. The lead has changed hands 4 times this season.
plots.next: Cherag could strike back from second, with Nihal already 14 points further adrift in third.
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

plots.title: Edd Keeps the Heat On
plots.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with 67 points in GW10 the latest recorded return. The only dip in the run came in GW8, when Edd scored 49.
plots.next: If the form holds, Edd could push the streak past 6 weeks and stretch the run further.
plots.question: How long can Edd stay hot?

plots.title: Tobi's Slow Recovery
plots.text: Tobi remains below the league average, now for 6 weeks in a row. A 58 in GW10 was a sharp rebound from 37, but the run is not yet broken.
plots.next: A second strong week could start to lift the slump, or another low score could deepen it.
plots.question: Can Tobi snap out of it?

piece.headline: Cherag's bench bites as the crown changes hands
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked for 21 captains, Dominic won the week with 75, and the title lead changed hands again.
piece.big_picture: Cherag's long reign at the top is over. Ayodele takes the crown, 8 clear. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, so nobody should get comfy. Sid is third, 29 off the pace.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan captained Barry instead of Haaland. 32 with the armband against 4 for the Haaland crowd, a 28-point swing. Nobody else dared. Nerve first, then a worldie.
piece.one_to_watch: Ayodele against Cherag again. If Gakpo starts repaying the transfer, Ayodele could stretch clear. If Cherag sorts the bench, the lead could flip straight back.

piece.headline: Cherag's bench bites as the crown changes hands
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked for 21 captains, Dominic won the week with 75, and the title lead changed hands again.
piece.big_picture: Cherag's long reign at the top is over. Ayodele takes the crown, 8 clear. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, so nobody should get comfy. Sid is third, 29 off the pace.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan captained Barry instead of Haaland. 32 with the armband against 4 for the Haaland crowd, a 28-point swing. Nobody else dared. Nerve first, then a worldie.
piece.one_to_watch: Ayodele against Cherag again. If Gakpo starts repaying the transfer, Ayodele could stretch clear. If Cherag sorts the bench, the lead could flip straight back.

title.title: The Crown Slips Away
title.text: Cherag holds the top spot on 665, but Ayodele is close behind on 657, just 8 points back. The lead has changed hands 3 times this season, and Sid sits 32 points adrift in third.

title.title: Ayodele Seizes the Crown
title.text: Ayodele overturned Cherag's lead, moving 8 points clear at 700 to 692 after Cherag had led for 6 weeks. This is Ayodele's first week on top this season, and the lead has changed hands 4 times.
title.next: Cherag could hit back quickly, and Sid sits 29 points off the lead.

title.title: Ayodele Stretches His Lead
title.text: Ayodele holds the top spot on 728, 11 clear of Cherag on 717, after taking the crown from Cherag's 6-week reign in GW10. The lead has changed hands 4 times this season.
title.next: Cherag could strike back from second, with Nihal already 14 points further adrift in third.

gamble:3506595:10.title: Hishaan's Bold Armband
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan backed Barry as captain, a choice only one manager made, and it returned 32 points. The gamble lifted Hishaan from 14th to 8th while most managers followed Haaland, who was captained by 21.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Armband Pays Off
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan's lone Barry armband paid off with 32 points, a gamble only one manager took. The move has carried Hishaan up to 9th from 14th, while 21 managers followed Haaland.

chase:4922092.title: Ravi Closes In
chase:4922092.text: Ravi has chased Bhavik down from 32 points behind in GW7 to 14 in GW8 and then just 1 in GW9. Live in GW10, the pair are now level.

gold.title: Fight for the Gold
gold.text: Only 4 spots sit in the Gold zone, and Nihal currently holds the last one. Nanik is first out, 5 points behind, and both have spent 2 of the last 5 weeks inside the zone.

rivalry:3506595-7471754.title: Hishaan vs Tonna
rivalry:3506595-7471754.text: Hishaan and Tonna have swapped places 6 times this season, and Tonna once led by 31 points in GW8. Live in GW10, Hishaan has pulled back ahead by 8.

underdog:573491.title: Nihal's Climb Holds
underdog:573491.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 4th, and has held that spot for 2 weeks. The climb has been steady, with places gained in almost every week since GW3.
underdog:573491.next: If the climb continues, Nihal could be a serious challenger for the top 3.

underdog:573491.title: Nihal Storms the Top 3
underdog:573491.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 3rd, a rise of 23 places and a step up from 4th last week. The top 2 are now within reach of a sustained push.
underdog:573491.next: If Nihal keeps gaining, the question shifts from climbing the table to chasing the leader, 14 points back.

chase:3506595.title: Hishaan Draws Level
chase:3506595.text: Hishaan has cut a 47-point deficit to Bhavik down to nothing, and the 2 are now level. The gap has shrunk every week since GW7.
chase:3506595.next: Whoever scores next could take the lead, and the chase is now in the open.

hot:1378937.title: Edd Keeps Rolling
hot:1378937.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with a 67-point return in GW10. The only dip came in GW8, when Edd scored 49.
hot:1378937.next: If Edd keeps this up, a 7th straight week above average is on the cards.

hot:1378937.title: Edd Keeps the Heat On
hot:1378937.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with 67 points in GW10 the latest recorded return. The only dip in the run came in GW8, when Edd scored 49.
hot:1378937.next: If the form holds, Edd could push the streak past 6 weeks and stretch the run further.

slump:383423.title: Tobi's Bounce Back
slump:383423.text: Tobi is still below the league average, but 58 points in GW10 is a sharp rebound from 37 the week before. The run now stands at 6 weeks below average.
slump:383423.next: A second strong week could be the start of a turnaround for Tobi.

slump:383423.title: Tobi's Slow Recovery
slump:383423.text: Tobi remains below the league average, now for 6 weeks in a row. A 58 in GW10 was a sharp rebound from 37, but the run is not yet broken.
slump:383423.next: A second strong week could start to lift the slump, or another low score could deepen it.

fall:5873092.title: Justin's Slide Continues
fall:5873092.text: Justin has dropped from 7th in GW6 to 17th, having bottomed out at 18th in GW9. A single place back in GW10 is the first hint of a turn.
fall:5873092.next: Could Justin claw back towards the top 10, or slide further?

chase:573491.title: 3 Points Adrift
chase:573491.text: Cherag's lead over Nihal has shrunk from 56 in GW8 to 22 in GW10, and stands at just 3 in the live GW11 figures. Nihal is closing in on the man ahead.
chase:573491.next: If Nihal finishes ahead of Cherag this week, the head-to-head rivalry could flip completely.
